items.title: Denise Morel Interview, 1965-05-07
items.q: Oh, I see the wedding of Bechet in Antibes.

ctx.x: Yeah. But, again, I keep changing the subject, excuse me. But when Bechet was alive, did you ever see a jazz brass band in Paris or in Europe? No. Not even for his wedding?
Oh, I see the wedding of Bechet in Antibes. It was a big part, but a very French one, I think.
